material.acceptance_criteria: prd-add with overwrite:true and only a disposition keeps the row's description, acceptance and witness plan unchanged.
material.description: The HUD shard set a disposition with prd-add and overwrite:true. The call wiped four rows' bodies. The lane restored them from text it had read earlier, so the triage detail survives only as condensed notes. A rescoping overwrite should keep the fields a call does not name, and a disposition change should never write an empty body.
